entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Support.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit Support. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. Order number is VF88-1219-4B.
Okay, let me pull that up for you. One moment... VF88-1219-4B. I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered on December 19th.
Correct. I need a return label.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference issue. I don't want it. Just send the label.
I understand. Looking at the delivery date, which was 19 days ago, I see we're just outside the 10-day return window for the VeloBand Pulse.
No. I tried to return this on day nine. Your entire website was down. I have a screenshot of the error page.
I see. Let me look into that for you. Can you confirm the exact date you attempted the return?
It was December 28th. The portal just kept giving me a website error message and I couldn't print the label. It was a complete waste of my time.

Thank you for that information. I am checking our system status logs for that day right now... And yes, I can confirm that. It looks like we had a known system down event that afternoon which impacted the returns portal. I am very sorry you experienced that.
So you'll process the return?

Absolutely. Since the website error was on our end and it prevented you from processing the return within the policy window, I'm overriding the system and approving a full refund for you. I've just processed the return authorization. You should receive an email with the pre-paid shipping label within the next five minutes.
Okay. That's fine. Thank you.
You're welcome. Once we receive the device back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
